decisions.reason: As a mobile usability component tied to the core geospatial offering and once given prominent home-page visibility, it still benefits from prior development and public commitment, even though its lower recent visibility makes eventual discontinuation somewhat more plausible.

Because this GIS platform is a flagship product line closely linked to the firm’s stated strategic direction, the accumulated investment, responsibility, and need to justify that commitment make withdrawal within the next year unlikely.

As a search extension within the firm’s established web-map domain, it remains easier to defend and retain than to abandon quickly, although as a narrower add-on with no recent observed promotion it faces more discontinuation risk than the flagship platform.
